intent: Full currents ladder reset after a ~10-week freeze, authored PURELY ON CHART EVIDENCE. PD input is disregarded for this week at PD/MD's instruction (2026-09-28) and will be reinstated as the base template from the following week per Config 6. Every currents record is past max dwell and the whole N category is past its 2-week dwell, so this executes the standing rules rather than making a discretionary sweep. Placement is set by the 2026-09-28 baseline pull against the 11.2 rescaled floors (A1 top-8, A2 top-15, B top-25-or-Spincrease). Adds bypass N for this reset only: a record that charted nationally while the ladder was frozen has already been auditioned.

basis.pd_input: DISREGARDED this week by PD/MD instruction; to be supplied separately for following weeks

notes: AUTHORED WITHOUT PD INPUT. No row cites a PD call, for or against. Every placement rests on a chart position, a Spincrease/Taking Off appearance, or documented absence from every panel source.
MINIMAL-CHANGE PRINCIPLE. Records are moved only where evidence justifies a move. Anything neither promoted nor demoted stays where it is - no arbitrary reshuffling was needed to hit depth.

N lands at 1, not 0. Nothing But Thieves 'Evolution' (id 632) is deliberately HELD in N by PD/MD decision 2026-09-30: it is on ALT Taking Off! now (1 new station, 8 new spins), which is 11.5's recall trigger, so retiring it to ZN and recalling it next week would be a no-op round trip. N has no hold state, which is what would otherwise have forced the retirement - see note 7. The remaining 17 N seats cannot be filled from the library and require sourcing; see sheets/2026-10-04-sourcing.md D. This still breaches the 11.2 hard +/-1 band.

DROPS DEFERRED. 11.3's triggers need archive history ('fell_off' for 2 consecutive weeks, negative trajectory) and 2026-09-28 is the FIRST archived week (7a rule 4). Nothing is dropped on that basis. The seven benchings rest on present-tense evidence - absent from every panel source plus expired max dwell - which needs no history.

BENCH vs HOLD is decided by ARTIST activity, not record activity. A non-charting record whose artist charts with a different single (Config 7b) is held in the ladder pending sourcing; a record whose artist appears nowhere is benched. 13 such 7b conflicts were found.
Three Days Grace 'Don't Wanna Go Home Tonight' (634) is NOT moved: it charts at ALT #19 and holds its A2 seat. Floors gate promotions, not holds, so no floor-miss applies.

RULE ARTIFACT, raised for a Config 6 amendment: N has no hold state, so a record whose N dwell expires must be promoted or retired even when it is actively gaining on Taking Off!. That mechanically retires records 11.5 would immediately recall. Either N needs an explicit hold-on-momentum exception, or the recall path needs to be able to fire in the same week as the retirement.
